integrity: Finite rational checks supplement, but cannot replace, the analytic proof; no formal certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: One initial active root frog, one frog per vertex, loopless complete graph, geometric lifetime and fixed c.
Poisson convergence and an \(O(1/\log n)\) error were established in prior epidemic work; novelty is specifically the sharp coefficient and quantitative mixture.
Independent scientific audit and historical-priority certification have not been performed.
title: Sharp \(1/\log n\) Poisson defect for geometric-lifetime frogs on complete graphs
